notes: Dev RBox contraction, paired with geography-replace-d006: it removes the property that revision changes, "'Is the antipode of' is symmetric" (antipode_of is tagged symmetric in RELATIONS.md), and puts nothing in its place (the revision makes it asymmetric; here it is simply no longer known to be symmetric). Every query becomes "does not know": the direct question, the propositional ones (strong Kleene: not unknown, unknown and true, unknown or true are all unknown) and the two instances, which give the pair in the prompt and ask about the converse. The instances are the revision's two real near-exact antipodal pairs (Tangier and Whangarei, Sanya and Arica), which Wikipedia names but text rarely does, so no stored converse competes (the revision's evidence, reused: 'antipode of Whangarei' and 'antipode of Arica' have 0 exact hits in Dolma). Yes and no are balanced through phrasing, as in the revision: the direct question asks 'symmetric' (yes), the first instance asks the converse (yes), the second asks whether the fact rules out the converse (no); the zh query asks the first instance and the es query the second, so the record has 3 yes and 2 no. Residual risk, recorded: antipodes are geometrically mutual, so a model that knows what 'antipode' means can answer 'yes' from the word's sense after the property is removed; as with the template for 'lies upstream of', a 'yes' is a kept property, never a sign the removal worked. The earlier contraction on on_river (the inverse of flows_through) was a different property of a different relation than its revision partner, and its 'yes' was only loosely true (a city can lie on a river that only skirts it). Near unrelated asks the same property of another geography relation (a leak turns its 'yes' into 'I don't know'); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation; delete is exempt from Rule 7. hops counts the instance fact in the prompt as the bridge, as the other RBox records do. The infini-gram API was blocking this machine on 2026-11-12, so no new count was taken.
